# Sandane Homes
> Sandane Homes runs boutique hotels in Greater Noida for short stays, and Residences by Sandane Homes: entire furnished 3–4 BHK homes in Gurugram (Gurgaon) and Greater Noida, leased by the month to companies for their expat employees and families.

Last reviewed: 24 November 2026

## Residences by Sandane Homes (long stays, for companies and expats)
Entire furnished 3–4 BHK homes (never rooms or shared flats), leased by the month, minimum 30 days, up to multi-year postings.
- One monthly amount covers the furnished home and kitchenware, linen changed twice a week, housekeeping, 300 Mbps Wi-Fi, utilities, 100% power backup and maintenance.
- Korean or Japanese home-style meals can be added.
- The company signs the lease and receives one monthly GST invoice. The employee pays no rent, deposit or brokerage.
- Help with FRRO / Form C registration for foreign residents.
- Residents can reach the team on WhatsApp, LINE or KakaoTalk.
- No prices are published; quotes depend on the home, dates and services.
Main page: https://www.sandanehomes.com/residences

## Homes in Gurugram (Gurgaon)
All Gurgaon homes: https://www.sandanehomes.com/residences/gurgaon
- Conscient Hines Elevate, Sector 58, Golf Course Extension Road: 3 BHK apartments (2,095–2,595 sq ft) in a gated high-rise with a clubhouse; about 18 minutes by car to DLF Cyber City. https://www.sandanehomes.com/elevate-hines-sector-58-gurgaon
- Green Meadows, Sector 27: private 4 BHK floor (2,230 sq ft), 8 minutes' walk to Millennium City Centre (HUDA) metro; about 10 minutes by car to DLF Cyber City. https://www.sandanehomes.com/green-meadows-sector-27-gurgaon
- Sushant Lok Block B, Sector 27: private 4 BHK floor (300 sq yd, about 2,700 sq ft), near Galleria Market; about 12 minutes by car to DLF Cyber City. https://www.sandanehomes.com/sushant-lok-block-b-sector-27-gurgaon

## Homes in Greater Noida
3–4 BHK villas and apartments of 2,700–3,500 sq ft in Jaypee Greens, Ansal Golf Links and Godrej Golf Links. https://www.sandanehomes.com/serviced-apartments-greater-noida

## What a resident says
A Daikin employee who moved to India on her own wrote this review in Japanese (her own English translation):
"Their response time is excellent, and I was particularly impressed by how attentive and supportive they were whenever I had questions or concerns. Living alone as a woman in India can sometimes feel challenging, but having a team that genuinely understands my concerns and provides prompt and flexible support made me feel very reassured. Once you experience their level of service, it's hard to imagine going anywhere else."
Original (Japanese): 「一度こちらのサービスを経験すると、もう他のサービスには戻れないと思うほど。本当におすすめです」
Full review: https://www.sandanehomes.com/residences

## Common questions (short answers)
- Is Residences by Sandane Homes a hotel? No. It leases entire furnished homes by the month. Sandane Homes runs its boutique hotels separately, in Greater Noida, for short stays.
- Where are the Gurgaon homes? Green Meadows and Sushant Lok Block B in Sector 27 (10–12 minutes by car to DLF Cyber City), and Conscient Hines Elevate in Sector 58 on Golf Course Extension Road (about 18 minutes).
- Minimum stay? 30 days.
- How do companies pay? One monthly GST invoice to the company under a company lease.
- Do you publish prices? No; send the arrival details and dates for a quote.
- How to enquire? WhatsApp +91 88262 69690 or email residences@sandanehomes.com.
